act1: I have got you. You will not miss what is gone.
There. Up you get. Your kit took the worst of it.
Easy. You are home. Whatever you dropped down there, leave it.
act2: I have got you. Your hands will shake a while. Let them.
Home again. You got further this time. I watched.
Lie still a moment. Something will feel missing. It passes.
act3: I have got you. Do not try to remember the fall. There is nothing in it worth keeping.
Back. Do not count what is missing. I count for both of us.
Sit a moment. Let the feeling pass. Trying to remember will only make it hurt.
act4: You keep coming back to me. That is all that matters.
Back. You asked me where you were. You always ask.
Up. The forge is lit and the lamps are on. Everything here is waiting on you.
known: I have got you. I always will. That was never the part that cost you.
Back again. You do not remember the first time I said that. I do.
Up. You know what I am now. You came back anyway. Of course you did.
wild: I have got you. Rest. There is so much room to cover.
Home again. Rest your hands. I will need them when you are ready.
